build_conv_layer_from_cfg: build a convolution layer from a config dict specifying type and layer arguments
build_default_conv2d_layer: build a default Conv2d layer by passing None as the config argument
register_conv_module: register a custom convolution module in the MODELS registry with a name and module class
build_conv1d_layer: build a Conv1d layer by passing a config dict with type set to Conv1d
build_conv3d_layer: build a Conv3d layer by passing a config dict with type set to Conv3d
